payload.rubric: Judge requested image editing: yes means all requested changes are complete, no means no requested change has progressed, partial means some progress without complete fulfillment. Unrelated edits are not requested progress. Insufficient evidence stays unresolved.

node.question: Does the edited image show the background changed into a basketball court?
node.criteria: Pass if the background itself is recognizably a basketball court, supported by visible court context such as a playing surface and court markings; basketball equipment may support this judgment but equipment alone is insufficient.
